resources.string: Mayo TV as your start screen
Mayo TV can open when you switch on the TV and come back whenever you press Home. Recommended, and you can also set it up later.
Set up
The Home button leads to Mayo TV
Wherever you are, one press of Home and you’re back here.
Straight in when you switch on
The box starts into Mayo TV, or straight into live TV if you prefer.
What the Home guard sees
Only which app is in front. Not what’s on screen, not your key presses, and it sends nothing anywhere.
You can change this any time in Settings › %1$s.
Switch on the Home guard
Mayo TV is your start screen
Android doesn’t let any app switch on its own accessibility service. You do it once in the box’s settings, in four short steps.
This box lets Mayo TV switch the Home guard on by itself. One click is all it takes.
Done. From now on, the Home button takes you to Mayo TV.
Choose “Open accessibility settings”.
Find “%1$s” in the list. It is often near the bottom, sometimes under “Services” or “Downloaded services”.
Switch it on and confirm. Android shows the same general warning about “full control” for every accessibility service. The guard still only sees which app is in front.
Press Back until you’re here again. The status changes to “Active” by itself.
By hand: Settings › System (on some boxes “Device Preferences”) › Accessibility › %1$s
Open accessibility settings
Switch on now
Choose Home app
This box also lets you pick the Home app yourself: choose Mayo TV there.
Not active yet
Checked again as soon as you’re back.
One click on the button below switches it on.
Active
The Home button takes you to Mayo TV.
Mayo TV is this box’s Home app.
Not switched on yet. No problem, just try again.
Not working on this box? Mayo TV works fine without the guard, and you can set it up later.
This box doesn’t let Mayo TV open its settings directly. Open them yourself with the gear icon and follow the steps above.
That didn’t work. Open the accessibility settings and switch the guard on there.
For experts
With a computer and ADB you can allow Mayo TV once to switch the guard on by itself. After that, one click here is enough:
When you switch on
What should appear when you turn on the box?
Mayo TV Home
Your home page with everything at a glance.
Live TV
The last channel you watched plays right away. Mayo TV also starts with live TV when you open it yourself.
Leave as it is
The box starts with its own start screen, as before.
Mayo TV doesn’t open by itself. With the Home guard on, it still appears as soon as the box’s own start screen comes up.
Note: without the Home guard, some boxes don’t let apps start by themselves after switching on. If it doesn’t work, set up the guard later.
